yahooNews.t: Closer Confidential: Ryan Helsley's Elbow Scare Puts Baltimore's Bullpen and Trade Deadline in Doubt
yahooNews.s: While you were celebrating, we were monitoring, so here’s your Week 15 primer for the back-ends of all the bullpens. Ryan Helsley landed on the injured list Friday, and Tyler Wells, not a name most fantasy managers rostered in any format, has saved back-to-back games in his place. Emilio Pagan is back in Cincinnati and, for once, the word “committee” does not apply to his bullpen anymore.

yahooNews.t: Rays beat the Yankees 3-0 to extend AL East lead to 5 games
yahooNews.s: Jonathan Aranda drove in three runs, Shane McClanahan pitched 6 1/3 innings and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the New York Yankees 3-0 on Wednesday night to extend their AL East lead to five games. McClanahan (8-5) scattered four hits and struck out five without a walk on 85 pitches. Bryan Baker struck out the side in the ninth inning for his 25th save.
